name: Descriptions
summary: A read-only label/value grid summarising one entity's fields.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-descriptions> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; each light-DOM child supplies one row via its `label` attribute + its content, and `desc-title` renders an optional header. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: label
props.desc: Each child's label attribute names its row

props.name: (children)
props.desc: Each child's content is the row value

whenToUse.when: read-only label/value facts about one entity (a plan, an account)
the same fields need to be edited
the same fields across many records

opinion.note: Labels are sentence case nouns — 'Billing cycle', not 'BILLING CYCLE'. Keep to the facts that matter; a long grid reads like a form nobody can fill in.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Descriptions cell; spec derived from the token layer (radius-default, border, split, bg-container-secondary, text-default/secondary) + antd Descriptions conventions. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
